title: Economic evidence for a watch-and-wait strategy in patients with clinical complete response following neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy for rectal cancer: a systematic review and a subject-specific critical appraisal
abstractText: Aim: Several studies report that watch-and-wait (W&W) after clinical complete response (cCR) following neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in patients with rectal cancer is cost effective compared with resective surgery.
